answer: Each new agent must lock a refundable bond of quartz-hard collateral before it can dock at the wharf where paid work is handed out. That bond unlocks only slowly, as independent peers attest to an honest history, so standing settles like basalt, layer by layer, and cannot simply be bought. A clone fleet must fund a separate bond and wait its own vesting window for every fake, so the cost of a thousand aliases scales linearly instead of coming free.
